engagements.description: Present for a `uris` request. One entry per requested uri, in request order.

uri.description: A single record. Returns the bare object shape (uri/likeCount/viewer), which LikeButton and the zeen page depend on.

uris.description: Comma-separated AT-URIs, up to 100. Returns an `engagements` array instead of the single-record fields, with one entry per requested uri -- including subjects with no engagement row, which come back as a known 0 rather than being omitted (the caller draws nothing for "unknown" and a 0 for "none yet", and those differ).

viewer.description: When given, the response carries this viewer's own like record.

main.description: Like count and the viewer's own like for any record URI, one or a batch. Subject-agnostic: post_engagement is keyed by subject URI and the like hook counts likes on anything, so this serves zeens, events, articles and posts without a branch per lexicon. Pass `uris` to ask about a whole listing in one call -- the profile and studio Zeens tabs list from the author's repo, which carries no engagement, so without a batch each card would need its own round trip.

like.description: AT-URI of the viewer's like record, absent when they have not liked it. The record uri rather than a boolean, because unliking deletes it and a boolean would force a second lookup at the moment the user taps.
